paragraphs.text: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה הָיָ֥ה רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת־צֹ֛אן יִתְר֥וֹ חֹתְנ֖וֹ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִדְיָ֑ן וַיִּנְהַ֤ג אֶת־הַצֹּאן֙ אַחַ֣ר הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֛א אֶל־הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽבָה׃

i18n.en: Now Moses was shepherding the flock of Yitro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian. He led the flock beyond the wilderness and came to the mountain of the Elohim, to Horeb.

paragraphs.commentary: The opening locates Moses at *har hā-ʾĕlōhîm ḥōrēḇāh* 'the mountain of the Elohim, to Horeb' — the divine-mountain that the Exodus tradition variously names Horeb (E-tradition / Deuteronomic) and Sinai (J/P-tradition). See the central entry `har-sinai-horev-the-mountain-of-Elohim-divine-mountain-cross-corpus` for the source-critical Horeb/Sinai variation and the cross-corpus reach to the broader Northwest-Semitic cosmic-mountain tradition (Clifford 1972 *The Cosmic Mountain in Canaan and the Old Testament*; Day 2000 *Yahweh and the Gods and Goddesses of Canaan*).

paragraphs.text: וַ֠יֵּרָא מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֵלָ֛יו בְּלַבַּת־אֵ֖שׁ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֑ה וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַסְּנֶה֙ בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְהַסְּנֶ֖ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אֻכָּֽל׃

i18n.en: And the messenger of YHWH appeared to him in a flame of fire from the midst of the bush. He looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, yet the bush was not consumed.

paragraphs.commentary: The *malʾaḵ YHWH* 'messenger of YHWH' appears at v 2; v 4 identifies the speaker as YHWH and the Elohim. This is the classic malakh-YHWH-as-YHWH fluidity-of-divine-bodies pattern documented by Sommer 2009 *The Bodies of God and the World of Ancient Israel* and at the central entry. Cross-corpus parallels at Gen 16, 22, Judg 6, 13. The *sneh* 'thorn-bush' lexeme is hapax-rare and carries possible wordplay to *sinay*.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אָסֻֽרָה־נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה אֶת־הַמַּרְאֶ֥ה הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה מַדּ֖וּעַ לֹא־יִבְעַ֥ר הַסְּנֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And Moses said, "Let me turn aside now and see this great sight — why the bush is not burned up."

paragraphs.text: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י סָ֣ר לִרְא֑וֹת וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֵלָ֨יו אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֗ה וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

i18n.en: When YHWH saw that he had turned aside to see, the Elohim called to him from the midst of the bush and said, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."

paragraphs.commentary: The doubled-name calling *mōšeh mōšeh* (cf. Gen 22:11 *avraham avraham*; Gen 46:2 *yaʿaqov yaʿaqov*; 1 Sam 3:10 *šĕmuʾēl šĕmuʾēl*) is the theophanic-doubled-name calling-formula. Moses' response *hinnēnî* 'here I am' is the prophetic-response formula deployed elsewhere by Abraham (Gen 22:1, 11), Jacob (Gen 31:11, 46:2), Samuel (1 Sam 3:4, 6, 8), and Isaiah (Isa 6:8).

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־תִּקְרַ֣ב הֲלֹ֑ם שַׁל־נְעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עוֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔יו אַדְמַת־קֹ֖דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃

i18n.en: And he said, "Do not draw near here. Take off your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֖ק וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיַּסְתֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנָ֔יו כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א מֵהַבִּ֖יט אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

i18n.en: And he said, "I am the Elohim of your father, the Elohim of Avraham, the Elohim of Yitzchaq, and the Elohim of Ya'aqov." And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at the Elohim.

paragraphs.commentary: The patriarchal-God-of-the-fathers formula with the threefold *ʾĕlōhê* repetition (preserved on the surface, not smoothed to a single 'Elohim of Avraham-Yitzchaq-and-Yaaqov') establishes the covenantal-continuity between the Sinai revelation and the patriarchal narratives of Genesis. See the central entry `elohei-avraham-yitzchaq-veyaakov-patriarchal-god-formula-cross-corpus` for the Albright-Alt-de Vaux tradition-historical framework and the NT cross-corpus at Mark 12:26-27 with operational disavowals.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה רָאֹ֥ה רָאִ֛יתִי אֶת־עֳנִ֥י עַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־צַעֲקָתָ֤ם שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י נֹֽגְשָׂ֔יו כִּ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־מַכְאֹבָֽיו׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said, "I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Mitsrayim, and I have heard their cry on account of their taskmasters; indeed, I know their pains.

paragraphs.commentary: The doubled infinitive-absolute *rāʾōh rāʾîṯî* 'I have surely seen' (cf. Gen 16:11, 31:42) is the emphatic-divine-attention formula; the WoH-Translation preserves the doubled-verb force ('I have surely seen') per the ASV-baseline convention rather than the JPS smoothing ('I have marked well').

paragraphs.text: וָאֵרֵ֞ד לְהַצִּיל֣וֹ ׀ מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֗יִם וּֽלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ֮ מִן־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִוא֒ אֶל־אֶ֤רֶץ טוֹבָה֙ וּרְחָבָ֔ה אֶל־אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֶל־מְק֤וֹם הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

i18n.en: And I have come down to deliver them from the hand of Mitsrayim and to bring them up out of that land to a good and broad land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

paragraphs.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֛ה צַעֲקַ֥ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣אָה אֵלָ֑י וְגַם־רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הַלַּ֔חַץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹחֲצִ֥ים אֹתָֽם׃

i18n.en: And now, behold, the cry of the children of Yisra'el has come to me, and I have also seen the oppression with which the Egyptians are oppressing them.

paragraphs.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔ה וְאֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֖ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְהוֹצֵ֛א אֶת־עַמִּ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And now, go, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Yisra'el, out of Mitsrayim."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ֣י אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אֵלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְכִ֥י אוֹצִ֛יא אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to the Elohim, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Yisra'el out of Mitsrayim?"

paragraphs.commentary: Moses' first commission-refusal *mî ʾānōḵî* 'who am I' is the prophetic-commission-refusal formula deployed across the prophetic-call narratives (Jer 1:6 'I am only a youth'; Judg 6:15 Gideon's 'my clan is the weakest'; 1 Sam 9:21 Saul's 'I am only a Benjamite'). The pattern is the prophet's-initial-protest-followed-by-divine-reassurance form-critical structure.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כִּֽי־אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְזֶה־לְּךָ֣ הָא֔וֹת כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י שְׁלַחְתִּ֑יךָ בְּהוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֤ אֶת־הָעָם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם תַּֽעַבְדוּן֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

i18n.en: And he said, "For I will be with you, and this shall be the sign for you that I have sent you: when you bring the people out of Mitsrayim, you shall serve the Elohim on this mountain."

paragraphs.commentary: *kî-ʾehyeh ʿimmāḵ* 'for I will be with you' deploys the same *ʾehyeh* verbal form that recurs at v 14 in the divine-name-revelation; the verses are deliberately paired by the Hebrew narrative. Propp 1999 ad loc. argues that this v-12 / v-14 *ʾehyeh* connection supports the future-aspectual 'I will be' reading of the divine-name (rather than the KJV traditional 'I am'). See the central entry `ehyeh-asher-ehyeh-divine-name-revelation-ex-3-14-cross-corpus` for the multi-stratum reading-history.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֣י בָא֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י לָהֶ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְאָֽמְרוּ־לִ֣י מַה־שְּׁמ֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to the Elohim, "Behold, I am going to the children of Yisra'el and I will say to them, 'The Elohim of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they will say to me, 'What is his name?' What shall I say to them?"

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽהְיֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And the Elohim said to Moses, "I am that I am." And he said, "Thus you shall say to the children of Yisra'el: 'I am has sent me to you.'"

paragraphs.commentary: **THE divine-name-revelation site of the Hebrew Bible.** The three-word formula *ʾehyeh ʾăšer ʾehyeh* is the single most-discussed lexical-philological site of the Tanakh. The WoH-Translation preserves the KJV/RSV traditional 'I am that I am' as the surface English-rendering; the five major reading-strata (KJV present-stative; JPS/Propp future-aspectual; LXX *ho ōn*; Albright causative-hiphʿil; process-theology becoming-one) are documented at the central entry `ehyeh-asher-ehyeh-divine-name-revelation-ex-3-14-cross-corpus`. Operational disavowals: no Christological pre-resolution (no 'ehyeh = preincarnate Christ via John 8:58'); no Raëlian-canon 'engineered-AI-presence-designator' reading; no Sitchin 'Anunnaki-faction-self-identification' fringe-reading. Acknowledgment-without-endorsement of the Raëlian-canon's engagement in *The Truth*, per the Shi'ur Qomah parasangs precedent and the Qur'an *inshiqāq al-qamar* precedent.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ע֨וֹד אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֹּֽה־תֹאמַר֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק וֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם זֶה־שְּׁמִ֣י לְעֹלָ֔ם וְזֶ֥ה זִכְרִ֖י לְדֹ֥ר דֹּֽר׃

i18n.en: And the Elohim said further to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the children of Yisra'el: 'YHWH, the Elohim of your fathers, the Elohim of Avraham, the Elohim of Yitzchaq, and the Elohim of Ya'aqov, has sent me to you. This is my name forever, and this is my memorial from generation to generation.'

paragraphs.commentary: The full-name revelation *YHWH ʾĕlōhê ʾăḇōṯêḵem* 'YHWH the Elohim of your fathers' with the threefold patriarchal-name expansion; *zeh-šĕmî lĕ-ʿōlām* 'this is my name forever'. The verse pairs the explicit YHWH-tetragrammaton with the v-14 *ʾehyeh* construct; cross-corpus to Ex 6:2-3 (the P-source name-revelation tradition) — the documentary-hypothesis tension is preserved without adjudication.

paragraphs.text: לֵ֣ךְ וְאָֽסַפְתָּ֞ אֶת־זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵהֶם֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ נִרְאָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם יִצְחָ֥ק וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֤ד פָּקַ֙דְתִּי֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הֶעָשׂ֥וּי לָכֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: Go and gather the elders of Yisra'el and say to them, 'YHWH, the Elohim of your fathers, has appeared to me — the Elohim of Avraham, Yitzchaq, and Ya'aqov — saying: I have surely visited you and what is being done to you in Mitsrayim,

paragraphs.commentary: The doubled *pāqōd pāqaḏtî* 'I have surely visited' is the Exodus-formula deliberately picking up Gen 50:24-25 (the Joseph promise: *pāqōḏ yip̄qōḏ ʾĕlōhîm ʾeṯḵem* 'the Elohim will surely visit you'). See the existing entry `paqod-yiphqod-divine-visitation-exodus-formula-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֮ מֵעֳנִ֣י מִצְרַיִם֒ אֶל־אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י אֶל־אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

i18n.en: and I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Mitsrayim to the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.'

paragraphs.text: וְשָׁמְע֖וּ לְקֹלֶ֑ךָ וּבָאתָ֡ אַתָּה֩ וְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֗יִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעִבְרִיִּים֙ נִקְרָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְעַתָּ֗ה נֵֽלֲכָה־נָּ֞א דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְנִזְבְּחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

i18n.en: And they will listen to your voice; and you shall go, you and the elders of Yisra'el, to the king of Mitsrayim, and you shall say to him: 'YHWH, the Elohim of the Hebrews, has met with us; and now, let us please go a three-days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to YHWH our Elohim.'

paragraphs.commentary: *ʾĕlōhê hā-ʿiḇriyyîm* 'the Elohim of the Hebrews' — first deployment of the Hebrews-as-ethnonym in the WoH-Exodus translation. See the existing entry `ha-ivri-hebrew-etymology` for the *Hebrew*-designation tradition and the cross-corpus reach.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֠י לֹֽא־יִתֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם לַהֲלֹ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃

i18n.en: But I know that the king of Mitsrayim will not allow you to go, even by a mighty hand.

paragraphs.text: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֤י אֶת־יָדִי֙ וְהִכֵּיתִ֣י אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹל֙ נִפְלְאֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֖ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And I will stretch out my hand and strike Mitsrayim with all my wonders that I will do in its midst; and after that he will send you out.

paragraphs.text: וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־חֵ֥ן הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה בְּעֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֵֽלֵכ֔וּן לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ רֵיקָֽם׃

i18n.en: And I will give this people favor in the eyes of Mitsrayim; and it shall come to pass that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

paragraphs.text: וְשָׁאֲלָ֨ה אִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ֙ וּמִגָּרַ֣ת בֵּיתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־כֶ֛סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּשְׂמָלֹ֑ת וְשַׂמְתֶּ֗ם עַל־בְּנֵיכֶם֙ וְעַל־בְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־מִצְרָֽיִם׃

i18n.en: Each woman shall ask of her neighbor and of the female who sojourns in her house articles of silver and articles of gold and garments; and you shall put them on your sons and on your daughters, and so you shall despoil Mitsrayim.

paragraphs.commentary: *nāṣaltem ʾeṯ-miṣrayim* 'you shall despoil Mitsrayim' — the Israelite-women-asking-for-silver/gold/clothing institution. The verb *nṣl* (Piʿel) 'to strip, despoil' is preserved on the surface rather than smoothed to 'plunder' or 'ask of'. Cross-corpus to Ex 12:35-36 (the Passover-narrative recall of the same institution). The moral-theological dispute over the despoiling-of-Egypt is documented in the rabbinic, patristic, and modern-critical reception (Childs 1974 ad loc.); the WoH-Translation preserves the literal Hebrew without softening.
